name: directory-manager
description: Keeps your Claude directory plugins healthy: lints plugin.json and README against Anthropic's listing rules before you push, reads every submission's status in the developer portal, tracks installs and where they come from, and requests publishes for passing versions.

pillars.supervised: Lint and status only read; stats read the portal and write two local files, uploading nothing. Portal skills are attended only. Publish is an outward action (it can make a version live, per the plugin's Auto-publish setting): the user starts it, sees per plugin whether the click goes to a reviewer or live, and says yes first, every time.
pillars.orchestrated: Plan > Act > Verify: read the portal, act on one plugin at a time, re-read the page to confirm.
pillars.secured: No credentials stored, no env vars read. Uses the user's own signed-in browser session on claude.ai/directory/manage and never copies cookies; the skills instruct Claude not to print, save or repeat secret values shown on portal pages.
